about: Golden vectors for the pricing contract (crates/providers/ARCHITECTURE.md, 'Pricing contract'). Each row is an ai.usage row; expect is what price(row) must return. An implementation must reproduce every one exactly. Absent row fields take their defaults: usage_wire anthropic, counts 0, strings null, booleans false, server_tools {}.

vectors.name: anthropic_basic
vectors.why: Opus 4.8 direct: input and output at the card.

vectors.name: anthropic_reasoning_inside_output
vectors.why: Thinking tokens are inside output_tokens; reasoning_tokens is a breakout and is never priced on its own.

vectors.name: anthropic_cache_read_5m_1h
vectors.why: Anthropic wire: input excludes cache reads and writes. 1h writes are a subset of cache_write_tokens, billed at 2x input; the rest at 1.25x.

vectors.name: anthropic_gateway_cache_writes
vectors.why: Writes from breakpoints the gateway added are already in input_tokens; the vendor bills them as 5-minute writes, and pass-through bills them the same.

vectors.name: anthropic_everything_together
vectors.why: Fast mode (2x every rate, caches included) x US-only inference (1.1x every token category) with cache reads, 5m and 1h writes and web search ($10/1k; the geo premium multiplies token categories only, so the fee is not multiplied).

vectors.name: anthropic_geo_us
vectors.why: inference_geo us: 1.1x on all token categories (Claude 4.6 and later).

vectors.name: anthropic_geo_global
vectors.why: inference_geo global is the standard price.

vectors.name: anthropic_geo_not_available
vectors.why: Anthropic reports inference_geo not_available on models without data residency (measured live on Haiku 4.5): no premium.

vectors.name: anthropic_geo_unsupported
vectors.why: Sonnet 4.5 rejects inference_geo (400); a row claiming it is refused.

vectors.name: anthropic_priority_tier_refused
vectors.why: Anthropic's own service_tier priority is Priority Tier (committed capacity, contract-priced), not fast mode: refused.

vectors.name: anthropic_fast_unsupported
vectors.why: Fast mode is not sold on Opus 4.7: refused, not billed at standard.

vectors.name: anthropic_web_fetch_free
vectors.why: Web fetch has no charge beyond tokens: a published $0 fee, priced.

vectors.name: anthropic_code_execution_unpriced
vectors.why: Code execution bills container-hours beyond a monthly free allowance: no per-row fee, refused.

vectors.name: anthropic_1h_exceeds_writes
vectors.why: 1h writes are a subset of the writes; more 1h than writes is an inconsistent row.

vectors.name: anthropic_gateway_writes_exceed_input
vectors.why: The gateway's writes are inside the uncached input; more of them than that is inconsistent.

vectors.name: anthropic_estimated
vectors.why: A cut-short stream's estimate is priced like any row and flagged estimated.

vectors.name: cache_hit_is_free
vectors.why: A response-cache hit makes no vendor call: cost 0 and price 0 (owner rule). The stored token facts stay on the row for audit.

vectors.name: cache_hit_unknown_model_still_free
vectors.why: A cache hit is free whatever it names: nothing was bought.

vectors.name: bedrock_us_profile
vectors.why: Bedrock's us. geo inference profile is billed at the Regional SKUs: +10% on every category, 1h writes included; pass-through, the customer pays the same.

vectors.name: bedrock_us_variant_stated
vectors.why: price_variant regional on Bedrock names what the candidate already is (a us. profile).

vectors.name: bedrock_global_variant_refused
vectors.why: A global Bedrock profile is not a catalog candidate: refused.

vectors.name: bedrock_fast_refused
vectors.why: Bedrock sells no fast mode; a fast row served there is refused on the cost side.

vectors.name: openai_wire_cached
vectors.why: OpenAI wire: input_tokens includes the cached tokens. 10000 input with 4000 cached is 6000 uncached plus 4000 at the cached rate, never 10000 + 4000.

vectors.name: openai_cache_exceeds_input
vectors.why: On the OpenAI wire cache reads are part of input; more cached than input is inconsistent.

vectors.name: openai_cache_writes_gpt_5_6
vectors.why: GPT-5.6 and later bill cache writes at 1.25x input, a third input rate inside input_tokens (not an extra fee).

vectors.name: openai_long_context_at_threshold
vectors.why: Long context starts at MORE than 272K input tokens: exactly 272000 is short.

vectors.name: openai_long_context_over_threshold
vectors.why: 272001 input tokens (cached included) bills the whole request at the long rates: 2x input and cache, 1.5x output.

vectors.name: openai_priority
vectors.why: service_tier priority (OpenAI's Fast mode) uses the published Fast table: 2.5x on gpt-5.5.

vectors.name: openai_fast_echo
vectors.why: OpenAI may echo service_tier fast: the same class as priority.

vectors.name: openai_priority_long_unpublished
vectors.why: Fast mode above 272K is unpublished for gpt-5.5: refused, not guessed.

vectors.name: openai_fast_long
vectors.why: GPT-5.6 and GPT-6 publish Fast long-context rates (2x the long rates).

vectors.name: openai_ultrafast_long
vectors.why: Ultrafast (6x) on GPT-6 Astra above 272K.

vectors.name: openai_flex
vectors.why: service_tier flex bills the Flex (Batch) rates.

vectors.name: openai_scale_refused
vectors.why: service_tier scale is not priced: refused.

vectors.name: openai_tools
vectors.why: Web search $10/1k search actions and file search $2.50/1k calls on a reasoning model; open_page / find_in_page actions, computer use, MCP and tool search are tokens only.

vectors.name: openai_search_non_reasoning
vectors.why: On a non-reasoning model the web_search tool is $10/1k calls; the row counts web_search_preview calls apart.

vectors.name: openai_search_preview_non_reasoning
vectors.why: web_search_preview on a non-reasoning model is $25/1k calls.

vectors.name: openai_search_preview_reasoning
vectors.why: web_search_preview on a reasoning model is $10/1k, like web_search.

vectors.name: openai_search_fixed_block_refused
vectors.why: gpt-4o-mini bills web search content as a fixed 8,000-token block the usage may not show: refused (the gateway also refuses the request, D268).

vectors.name: openai_container_refused
vectors.why: Code Interpreter is a container session, billed per minute by memory size, neither reported: refused.

vectors.name: openai_shell_refused
vectors.why: Hosted shell is a container session too: refused.

vectors.name: openai_image_generation_refused
vectors.why: The image_generation tool bills image tokens the response does not report: refused.

vectors.name: openai_embeddings
vectors.why: Embeddings: input only.

vectors.name: openai_responses_arm
vectors.why: A Responses request on a GPT row is served by OpenAI's responses arm: same provider, same card.

vectors.name: rounding_half_up
vectors.why: 10 tokens at $0.05/M is exactly 0.5 micro-dollars: rounds up to 1.

vectors.name: rounding_below_half
vectors.why: 9 tokens at $0.05/M is 0.45 micro-dollars: rounds to 0 (a priced zero, not unpriced).

vectors.name: rounding_once_per_side
vectors.why: Rounding is once per side on the exact sum: 9 input (0.45 µ$) + 1 output (0.40 µ$) = 0.85 µ$ rounds to 1, though each part alone rounds to 0.

vectors.name: xai_long_at_threshold
vectors.why: xAI's long tier applies when the prompt (cached included) REACHES 200k: exactly 200000 is long, every token at 2x.

vectors.name: xai_long_below_threshold
vectors.why: 199999 prompt tokens: standard.

vectors.name: xai_priority_and_tools
vectors.why: Priority is 2x every token type (caching applied first); web search $5/1k, X search $5/1k posts and $10/1k profiles, code execution $5/1k; the x_search call itself and MCP calls are tokens only.

vectors.name: xai_priority_long_unpublished
vectors.why: Priority above 200k is unpublished: refused.

vectors.name: deepseek_peak
vectors.why: Monday 02:00 UTC is peak (01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC, Mon-Fri): the card rate.

vectors.name: deepseek_off_peak
vectors.why: Monday 11:00 UTC is off-peak: half of every rate, for the customer too (the card follows its vendor's rules).

vectors.name: deepseek_weekend
vectors.why: Saturday is off-peak all day.

vectors.name: deepseek_window_start
vectors.why: 01:00:00 is the first peak minute.

vectors.name: deepseek_window_end
vectors.why: 04:00:00 is off-peak again (windows are half-open).

vectors.name: deepseek_window_last_minute
vectors.why: 03:59:59 is still peak.

vectors.name: deepseek_calendar_unknown
vectors.why: A weekday peak minute in 2027 is refused until the 2027 Chinese public holidays are recorded.

vectors.name: deepseek_calendar_unknown_off_peak
vectors.why: Outside the peak windows no calendar is needed: priced off-peak.

vectors.name: deepseek_via_together_off_peak
vectors.why: Served by Together off-peak: Together's flat rate (and its own cached rate) applies, not DeepSeek's off-peak half; pass-through, the customer pays Together's rate.

vectors.name: groq_flex_is_standard
vectors.why: Groq flex is priced as on-demand.

vectors.name: groq_on_demand
vectors.why: Groq echoes on_demand for its standard tier.

vectors.name: fireworks_failover
vectors.why: Failover to Fireworks: Fireworks' own card, for cost and price alike.

vectors.name: fireworks_priority
vectors.why: Fireworks served its Priority tier: its own priority rates, passed through.

vectors.name: together_list_card
vectors.why: A Together-primary row whose customer card is the catalog list price.

vectors.name: together_conflict_bound
vectors.why: Together publishes two prices for Qwen3.7 Max; the cost uses the dearer (a bound).

vectors.name: openrouter_reported_cost
vectors.why: OpenRouter's usage.cost plus the 5.5% credit fee is the cost, and the price (pass-through). The counts are OpenAI-wire: input includes cache reads AND cache writes.

vectors.name: openrouter_reported_cost_exponent
vectors.why: usage.cost may arrive in exponent form.

vectors.name: openrouter_reported_cost_tiny
vectors.why: Sub-micro-dollar costs round half-up per side: 4.7e-7 USD x 1.055 = 0.49585 µ$ rounds to 0.

vectors.name: openrouter_reported_cost_negative
vectors.why: A negative reported cost is refused.

vectors.name: openrouter_reported_cost_garbage
vectors.why: A non-numeric reported cost is refused.

vectors.name: openrouter_no_cost_host
vectors.why: No reported cost (a stream cut before its usage chunk): the dearest endpoint of the named host. Amazon Bedrock's include its eu-west-1 regional endpoint at +10%, so the bound is that one, plus the credit fee. Estimated.

vectors.name: openrouter_no_cost_no_host
vectors.why: No reported cost and no host: the dearest standard endpoint of the model.

vectors.name: openrouter_no_cost_long
vectors.why: Endpoint long-context overrides apply to the fallback (min_prompt_tokens, strictly greater).

vectors.name: openrouter_no_cost_fast
vectors.why: A fast-served OpenRouter row (service_tier priority plus usage.speed fast) falls back to the model's fast endpoints only.

vectors.name: openrouter_unknown_host
vectors.why: A host the endpoint list does not have is refused.

vectors.name: openrouter_pro_row
vectors.why: An OpenRouter-only row (gpt-6-sol-pro): OpenRouter's report plus fee, for cost and price alike.

vectors.name: openrouter_tool_cost_passed_through
vectors.why: A metered OpenRouter tool or plugin cost is inside the reported usage.cost: passed through with the fee.

vectors.name: openrouter_tool_cost_zero
vectors.why: A zero tool cost is no tool: priced.

vectors.name: openrouter_native_search
vectors.why: OpenRouter native web search on a Claude row: tool_calls counts it too and is not added; the reported cost carries the search.

vectors.name: openrouter_tool_calls_with_reported_cost
vectors.why: tool_calls beyond the web searches: another OpenRouter tool ran, and the reported cost carries it.

vectors.name: openrouter_regional_host
vectors.why: OpenRouter's in-region host (price_variant regional): the reported cost carries the surcharge.

vectors.name: openrouter_may_continue
vectors.why: A cancelled OpenRouter stream on a host that keeps generating: the row is a lower bound until reconciled, so estimated.

vectors.name: openrouter_tool_calls_no_cost_refused
vectors.why: tool_calls beyond the web searches and no reported cost: no endpoint lists that tool's fee, so refused.

vectors.name: xai_reported_cost
vectors.why: xAI reports its own cost (cost_in_usd_ticks): that is the cost and the price, with no fee.

vectors.name: xai_document_search_refused
vectors.why: xAI document_search has no published fee under that name: refused.

vectors.name: xai_sources_refused
vectors.why: xAI legacy Live Search sources: refused.

vectors.name: unknown_tool_kind
vectors.why: A server_tools kind the pricer has never heard of may have a fee: refused.

vectors.name: bad_tool_count
vectors.why: A server_tools count that is not a number: refused.

vectors.name: unpriced_no_price_model
vectors.why: A model the catalog does not carry has no price_model: refused, never zero.

vectors.name: unpriced_unknown_model
vectors.why: A price_model that is not a catalog row.

vectors.name: unpriced_no_provider
vectors.why: No provider was called (every breaker open) but tokens were reported: refused.

vectors.name: unpriced_not_a_candidate
vectors.why: A provider that is not a candidate of the row.

vectors.name: unpriced_unknown_geo
vectors.why: inference_geo eu is not priced.

vectors.name: unpriced_class_conflict
vectors.why: Flex and fast at once is not a class.

vectors.name: unpriced_overflow
vectors.why: A nonsense token count overflows 128 bits: refused, not wrapped.
